summary: No installer-harm signals observed in w-mousekey@1.0.42
details: Analysis of w-mousekey@1.0.42 produced no indicators of installer-side harm. No install-time or import-time execution of attacker-controlled code, no exfiltration of environment variables or credentials, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no silent relay of caller-supplied data to a hardcoded author endpoint, no backdoor or persistence mechanism, and no self-propagation primitives were observed in the package contents.
